name: Recall
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Recall, save user-provided sources, summarize them, and build a linked personal knowledge graph. The hard boundary is hosted extraction, model routing, browser capture, sync, and knowledge-graph polish, plus capture polish, sync, and content partnerships.
